answer: I would anchor trust in Cross-chain name age proof. With a name registered two years ago on another chain, a single jade check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a name registered two years ago on another chain takes calendar time as well as money — and the nectar is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The river grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
